script: PHI +3 in a 39 total is a tight, low-possession game, so Carolina laying the field goal can stay on schedule with Chuba Hubbard (52 carries, 257 yards over weeks 2-4) instead of chasing. Philadelphia's cleaner path is the ground too — Carolina allows 5.51 YPC and 14 runs of 10+ in 4 games — but Saquon Barkley has only 17 carries for 90 yards in his last 3, so the Eagles' touches are split with Tank Bigsby (14/55), Dameon Pierce (11/14) and Jalen Hurts (11/45) rather than concentrated.
who_goes_off: Tetairoa McMillan is the one who should go off: 31 targets, 310 receiving yards and 328 air yards over Carolina's last 3, into a Philly defense that blitzes just 23%, the look where Bryce Young is better (0.25 EPA/dropback unblitzed vs 0.17 vs blitz, n=42). Hubbard is the other, a 17.3-carry bellcow at 85.7 rush yards per game, well clear of a 70.5 number if the CAR -3 script holds.
weak_spot: Philly's pass defense leaks to the left at 7.46 YPA on 54 attempts and has allowed 15 gains of 20+ on 185 attempts; the middle is their best spot at 6.60 YPA on 47 attempts, so McMillan's 10.6 aDOT still has a side to attack, while the run (4.09 YPC, 13 runs of 10+ in 5 games) is only average. Carolina's real hole is the run at 5.51 YPC, with the middle the aerial soft spot at 7.84 YPA on 37 attempts against 5.90 YPA to the right on 61 attempts.
injury_fallout: No injuries are listed in the pre-kickoff data, so the fallout is the usage already on the sheet: A.J. Dillon (12 carries, 15 yards) and Jonathon Brooks (5 carries, 16 yards) are empty, which locks Carolina's run game to Hubbard. Philly's backfield is a four-way split, so Pierce's 11 carries for 14 yards and -2 receiving yards do not support a 64.5 rush+rec role, and Dallas Goedert's 9 targets for 38 yards show he is not the featured answer either.
qb_vs_blitz: Bryce Young is positive in both looks (0.17 EPA vs blitz on 42 dropbacks, 0.25 with no blitz) and Philly blitzes only 23%, so he should mostly see the cleaner pocket. Hurts is the mismatch: -0.21 EPA vs blitz on 70 dropbacks against a Panthers blitz rate of 36%, versus 0.00 EPA when unblitzed, which caps Dontayvion Wicks (18 targets, 113 yards), Makailemon (17 targets, 99 yards) and Goedert (9 targets, 38 yards).

picks.why: McMillan has 31 targets and 310 yards over three games, 103.3 a game, against a 64.5 line. Philly blitzes 23% and Young is better unblitzed (0.25 EPA), and that defense has already allowed 15 passes of 20+ on 185 attempts, so a cut from 10.3 targets to 8 at Philly's 6.60-7.46 YPA band still lands on the over side of 64.5.

Hubbard has 257 yards on 52 carries (4.94 YPC, 85.7 per game) versus a 70.5 line in a CAR -3, 39-total script that does not force him off the field. Philly's 4.09 YPC allowed is the tax, but 17 carries at even 4.2 YPC is 71, and Dillon plus Brooks have combined for 31 yards on 17 carries, so the volume is not leaving.
